subject.title: fix(onboarding): stop recommending tools setup cannot activate

question: Should the shared no-inference catalog advertise only routes guided setup can detect and activate, or also advertise advanced tools that require separate provider or ACP setup?
rationale: Both policies are technically possible, but removing five newly introduced cross-client recommendations is a product-discovery choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Use guided-only recommendations
options.body: Merge the four-entry catalog and keep advanced tools discoverable only through their accurate provider or ACP setup flows.

options.title: Keep route-specific advanced cards
options.body: Retain selected advanced tools only after replacing the generic check-again action with links or actions for their actual setup paths.

options.title: Pause catalog narrowing
options.body: Hold the PR until the onboarding feature owner documents whether the catalog is activation guidance or broader ecosystem discovery.

recommendation.title: Use guided-only recommendations
recommendation.body: Merge the four-entry catalog and keep advanced tools discoverable only through their accurate provider or ACP setup flows.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared catalog and its cross-client product behavior in the immediately preceding merged feature.
